label: Gatterer 1769 defines genealogical truth and Evidenz through source-proposition agreement and inspectability

features.value: genealogical truth consists in agreement between sources and genealogical propositions drawn from them
Evidenz occurs when source-proposition agreement or identity is displayed so it can be perceived immediately and without effort
agreement should effectively fall into the eye and be surveyable almost at a glance
sources should not merely be cited; relevant proof passages should be reproduced verbatim
genealogical proposition and proof passage should be placed immediately together
disposition reduces navigational and comparison distance but does not replace source criticism

sources.citation: GenWiki transcription from Göttingen digitisation, Von der Evidenz in der Genealogie (Gatterer), transcription p. 10

label: Gatterer 1769: Duchesne has proof passages but fails full Evidenz through disposition

features.value: Duchesne method reproduces proof passages verbatim and deserved widespread approval
propositions and proofs are not brought close enough for their identity to be perceived quickly
propositions remain compressed in Stammtafeln rather than each appearing individually with its proof
correct evidentiary material can fail to produce Evidenz when disposition impedes rapid inspection

sources.citation: GenWiki transcription from Göttingen digitisation, Von der Evidenz in der Genealogie (Gatterer), transcription p. 11

notes: Treat as a layout/disposition critique, not as a rejection of Duchesne's source practice. Exact wording requires page-image control.

label: Gatterer 1769 retrospectively identifies Holzschuher 1755 table-text navigation as his genealogical practice

features.value: Stammtafeln should indicate paragraphs or sections where each person's historical and genealogical particulars are narrated
Gatterer names his own Holzschuher genealogy as an example of this arrangement
self-reference supports continuity of navigation architecture, not proof that the full 1769 Evidenz theory already existed in 1755

sources.citation: GenWiki transcription from Göttingen digitisation, Von der Evidenz in der Genealogie (Gatterer), transcription p. 10

notes: High-value bridge to the 1755 corpus. Direct copy-level verification of the actual paragraph references in Holzschuher remains outstanding.

label: Sprengel worked example immediately follows Gatterer's 1769 Evidenz method
date_note: Gierl bibliographic convention dates Sprengel contribution 1768; carrier publication is AHB 12, 1769.

features.value: Gatterer method essay pp.3-17 immediately followed by worked example pp.18-46
Gierl describes the example as Tafel und Erläuterungen, p.19ff
inspect exact spatial coordination of table, proposition, proof, numbering and explanatory text

sources.citation: Allgemeine historische Bibliothek 12 (1769), contents: Beyspiel zur Erläuterung der Gattererschen Methode begins p.18

Martin Gierl, Geschichte als präzisierte Wissenschaft / Fundamenta Historica, Abb. 26: Matthias Christian Sprengel, Beispiel zur Erläuterung der Gattererschen Methode in der Genealogie, Tafel und Erläuterungen, p.19ff

notes: Do not attribute the worked example to Gatterer as author. Exact layout remains a direct-page target.
